_note: Team-written plain-language statements of common depression symptoms (domains similar to standard questionnaires; wording is our own). Each writing's similarity to each statement is one interpretable feature.

symptoms.sadness: I feel sad, down and unhappy most of the time.
symptoms.hopelessness: I feel hopeless about the future and expect things to only get worse.
symptoms.failure: I feel like a failure and that I have let everyone down.
symptoms.anhedonia: Nothing is fun anymore and I no longer enjoy the things I used to love.
symptoms.guilt: I feel guilty all the time about things I did or did not do.
symptoms.deserve_punishment: I feel like I deserve to be punished.
symptoms.self_hate: I hate myself and I am disappointed in who I am.
symptoms.self_blame: I blame myself for everything that goes wrong.
symptoms.self_harm: I have been thinking about hurting myself or ending my life.
symptoms.crying: I cry a lot these days, often for no reason.
symptoms.restlessness: I feel restless and agitated and I cannot sit still.
symptoms.withdrawal: I have lost interest in other people and stopped doing things with them.
symptoms.indecision: I find it very hard to make even small decisions.
symptoms.no_energy: I have no energy left to do anything.
symptoms.sleep: I cannot sleep at night, or I sleep far too much.
symptoms.irritability: I get irritated and angry very easily lately.
symptoms.appetite: I have lost my appetite, or I eat far too much to cope.
symptoms.concentration: I cannot concentrate or focus on anything anymore.
symptoms.exhaustion: I am tired and exhausted all the time.
symptoms.loneliness: I feel completely alone and nobody cares about me.
